open_points.subject: functions.submit_implementation / activation when verdict is reused
open_points.text: "Submitting an implementation — new, or equal to an existing one — runs admission unless an AdmissionVerdict M08 for that implementation and the current corpus digest already exists, in which case that verdict is used." (A04 rule 2) + "An `admitted` verdict is followed at once, in the same request, by an Activation M09 ..." (A04 rule 4) vs State impact: "then, unless a verdict is reused, one `record_trial_execution` per case and `record_admission_verdict`."
open_points.question: If an admitted verdict already exists for the current corpus and the implementation is not currently active, must submit_implementation record a new Activation in this request?
options: Yes: reuse the verdict and still activate when not current.
No: verdict reuse never records activation.
Only activate on new admission executions, not on reused verdicts.
open_points.default_guess: Yes: reuse verdict and still write Activation when implementation is not current.

open_points.subject: store.read_records relation "trial executions of an implementation over a corpus digest"
open_points.text: "trial executions of an implementation over a corpus digest ... per case of that corpus ... the implementation's latest TrialExecution M07 in store order — from admission or a try alike"
open_points.question: How is a TrialExecution from try_implementation determined to be "over" a specific corpus digest, given M07 fields do not include corpus_digest?
options: Store a separate try-session record linking executed cases to a corpus digest.
Treat only admission TrialExecutions as belonging to a corpus digest; exclude try executions.
open_points.default_guess: Store corpus_digest on each TrialExecution (or equivalent persisted linkage).

open_points.subject: effects.recover_in_flight_attempts / approval status update
open_points.text: State 5: "Every `in_flight` attempt becomes `unknown`, its missing NodeExecution `outcome_unknown`, its approval `used`" vs State 4 start flow: "the approval the attempt named, if any, is marked `used`."
open_points.question: When recovering an in-flight attempt whose authority was a standing grant or flow activation (no approval), what approval update is required?
options: No approval update is performed when authority has no approval.
Recovery must fail as inconsistent if no approval exists.
Create a synthetic approval and mark it used.
open_points.default_guess: No approval update when the attempt authority is not an approval.
